game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Sunken Wreck, a wreck beneath the waves: the harbor master must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Elif Ladder: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each.
theme: Coastal Port – Sunken Wreck: a wreck beneath the waves
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunken Wreck, repeat each round: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each. Each round, a new cargo crates challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the threat_level value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of cargo crates by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Elif Ladder
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Elif Ladder' (Week 3 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sunken Wreck'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how threat_level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Sunken Wreck.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 36 seconds.
